title: IBM MQ - Overview
description: Every queue manager at a glance: what needs attention now, status, deepest queues, oldest messages and channels. From mq_otel (iyzitrace-poc docs/07-ibm-mq.md).

panels.title: Not running
panels.description: Queue managers that report a status other than Running.

panels.title: Not reporting
panels.description: Seen in the last hour, no metrics now: the queue manager, its listener or its mq_otel is down.

targets.expr: count(max by (qmgr) (last_over_time(ibmmq_qmgr_status_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr"}[1h])) unless on (qmgr) last_over_time(ibmmq_qmgr_status_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr"}[90s])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Channels down
panels.description: Channels between queue managers that are stopped, retrying or starting.

panels.title: On dead-letter queues
panels.description: Messages waiting on the dead-letter queue ($dlq) of the selected queue managers.

panels.title: Queues > 80% full
panels.description: Queues whose depth is above 80% of their MAXDEPTH: puts fail when one is full.

panels.title: Messages > 5 min old
panels.description: Queues, apart from the dead-letter queue, whose oldest message waits longer than 5 minutes: nobody reads them, or not fast enough.

panels.title: Queue managers
panels.description: One row per queue manager; click a name for its own dashboard. A queue manager that stopped sending metrics in the last hour shows as Not reporting.

targets.expr: count by (qmgr) (last_over_time(ibmmq_channel_status_squash_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr", type!="SVRCONN"}[90s]) < 2) or max by (qmgr) (last_over_time(ibmmq_qmgr_status_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr"}[90s])) * 0
max by (qmgr) (ibmmq_queue_depth_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr", queue="$dlq"}) or max by (qmgr) (last_over_time(ibmmq_qmgr_status_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr"}[90s])) * 0

panels.title: Status history
panels.description: Each queue manager's status over the time range; red where it was down or sent nothing.

panels.title: Deepest queues
panels.description: The 15 queues with the most messages, empty ones left out; click one for its dashboard.

targets.expr: (max by (qmgr, queue) (ibmmq_queue_depth_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr"}) / max by (qmgr, queue) (ibmmq_queue_attribute_max_depth_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr"}) * 100) and on (qmgr, queue) topk(15, max by (qmgr, queue) (ibmmq_queue_depth_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr"}) > 0)
max by (qmgr, queue) (ibmmq_queue_oldest_message_age_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr"}) and on (qmgr, queue) topk(15, max by (qmgr, queue) (ibmmq_queue_depth_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr"}) > 0)
sum by (qmgr, queue) (rate(ibmmq_queue_mqget_count_total{qmgr=~"$qmgr"}[5m])) and on (qmgr, queue) topk(15, max by (qmgr, queue) (ibmmq_queue_depth_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr"}) > 0)

panels.title: Oldest messages
panels.description: The 15 queues, apart from the dead-letter queue, whose oldest message waits longest; click one for its dashboard.

targets.expr: max by (qmgr, queue) (ibmmq_queue_depth_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr"}) and on (qmgr, queue) topk(15, max by (qmgr, queue) (ibmmq_queue_oldest_message_age_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr", queue!="$dlq"}) > 0)
max by (qmgr, queue) (ibmmq_queue_time_since_get_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr"}) and on (qmgr, queue) topk(15, max by (qmgr, queue) (ibmmq_queue_oldest_message_age_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr", queue!="$dlq"}) > 0)
max by (qmgr, queue) (ibmmq_queue_input_handles_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr"}) and on (qmgr, queue) topk(15, max by (qmgr, queue) (ibmmq_queue_oldest_message_age_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr", queue!="$dlq"}) > 0)

panels.title: Channels
panels.description: Sender, receiver and cluster channels with a status, stopped ones first. Channels that never started or are inactive have no status and are not listed.

targets.expr: max by (qmgr, channel, type, rqmname, connname) (last_over_time(ibmmq_channel_status_squash_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr", type!="SVRCONN"}[90s]))
max by (qmgr, channel, type, rqmname, connname) (last_over_time(ibmmq_channel_status_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr", type!="SVRCONN"}[90s]))
sum by (qmgr, channel, type, rqmname, connname) (rate(ibmmq_channel_messages_total{qmgr=~"$qmgr", type!="SVRCONN"}[5m]))
max by (qmgr, channel, type, rqmname, connname) (ibmmq_channel_xmitq_time_short_ratio{qmgr=~"$qmgr", type!="SVRCONN"}) / 1e6
